test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word from the following sentence.**

**Decent**

My father taught me to be true and ethical in business, as dishonesty leads to downfall.
solution: The correct answer is **"dishonesty."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Decent"** means conforming to standards of propriety, good taste, or morality. (शालीन; उचित, उपयुक्त) • **Example**: *All she wants is a **decent**__ job with __**decent**__ wages.* • **"Dishonesty"** means the practice of being dishonest; lack of straightforwardness. (बेईमानी, धोखा) __ • **Example**: *Mistakes and misunderstandings are a far more common cause of complaint than deliberate **dishonesty**__.* • Therefore, **"dishonesty"** is the most appropriate antonym for** "decent."** • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "ethical" **means relating to moral principles or the branch of knowledge dealing with these. (उचित-अनुचित के विचार से संबंधित; नैतिक) • **Option 3, "downfall"** means a sudden loss of power, prosperity, or status. (धन, सत्ता, समाज में आदर आदि की हानि, अधःपतन; अधःपतनकारी वस्‍तु) • **Option 4, "true" **means in accordance with fact or reality. (ठीक या सही) 3a:Tafc, The correct answer is **"Let me read the book."**
